# license-auditor

> Audit dependency licenses against an allowlist policy with SPDX license expressions, PEP 639 metadata and conservative classifier mapping. Python package `trysac-license-auditor`, import name `license_auditor`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
